## Load and build dataframe (Data from Matlab [Plotting_ERP.m])
```{r}
data <- read_excel("Data_ERP_results_Incongtrials_FCz_250728.xlsx") # Simple Model (Incongruent Trials, ERP, time -200 600)
Stimulation <- factor(data$Stimulation, levels = c(1, 2, 3), labels = c("aMCC", "SHAM", "PCC"))
Subject <- factor(data$Subjects)
Time <- data$TimePoint
Error <- factor(data$IncongCorrectIncorr, levels = c(1,0), labels = c("Correct", "Incorrect"))
ERP <- data$ERP
df <- data.frame(Subject,Time,Stimulation,ERP,Error)
df$Stimulation <- relevel(df$Stimulation,"aMCC")

```

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = Time, y = ERP, color = Stimulation, linetype = Error, fill = Stimulation)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 70, xmax = 120, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           alpha = 0.1, fill = "gray") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "ribbon", alpha = 0.2,
               aes(group = interaction(Stimulation, Error)), color = NA) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", size = 1,
               aes(group = interaction(Stimulation, Error))) +
  labs(title = "ERP Curves with SEM",
       y = "ERP (μV)", x = "Time (ms)") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("dashed", "solid")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "aMCC"  = "#CC6677",  # reddish purple
    "SHAM"   = "#E69F00",  # orange/yellow
    "PCC" = "#56B4E9"   # sky blue
  )) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "aMCC"  = "#CC6677",
    "SHAM"   = "#E69F00",
    "PCC" = "#56B4E9"
  )) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(25, -10)) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.title   = element_text(size = 18)
  )
```


#Compute ERN peak around 

```{r}

# Subset time window for ERN (50-150 ms), Incorrect trials only

# For each subject and stimulation, find the peak (most negative ERP value)
# Then extract values within ±20ms around that peak
df_ern_peaks <- df %>%
    filter(Time >= 70 & Time <= 120)%>%
  group_by(Subject, Stimulation,Error) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_ERP = mean(ERP),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


```



```{r}
# Convert factors
df_ern_peaks$Subject <- as.factor(df_ern_peaks$Subject)
df_ern_peaks$Stimulation <- as.factor(df_ern_peaks$Stimulation)

# Bayesian multilevel model for accuracy by task stage, stimulation, and congruence
library(brms)

# Relevel so Ventricles is the reference
df_ern_peaks$Stimulation <- relevel(df_ern_peaks$Stimulation, ref = "SHAM")

# Check what priors the model needs BEFORE defining them
get_prior(
  Mean_ERP ~ 1 + Stimulation*Error + (1 + Stimulation*Error || Subject),
  data   = df_ern_peaks,
  family = gaussian()
)

# Define priors
# Intercept prior should reflect realistic ERP beta range, not 7
# sd and sigma priors added — these were missing and brms uses flat priors otherwise
prior_model <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 10),   class = "Intercept"),
    prior(normal(0, 3), class = "b", coef= "ErrorIncorrect"),
    prior(normal(0, 3), class = "b", coef= "StimulationaMCC"),
  prior(normal(0, 3), class = "b", coef= "StimulationPCC"),
  prior(exponential(2), class = "sd"),           # random effect SDs
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sigma")         # residual SD
)


# Fit model
brms_ERP_model <- brm(
  Mean_ERP ~ 1 + Stimulation*Error + (1 + Stimulation*Error || Subject),
  data    = df_ern_peaks,
  family  = gaussian(),
  prior   = prior_model,
  chains  = 4,
  iter    = 4000,       # increased: complex random slopes need more samples
  warmup  = 2000,       # keep warmup = iter/2
  cores   = 4,
  seed    = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta   = 0.95,   # reduces divergent transitions
                 max_treedepth = 12),
  refresh = 500         # print progress every 500 iterations
)

# Diagnostics — run these before trusting results
plot(brms_ERP_model)           # trace plots: chains should mix well
pp_check(brms_ERP_model, ndraws = 100)  # posterior predictive check
summary(brms_ERP_model)        # check Rhat ≈ 1.00, ESS > 400

# Pairwise contrasts between stimulation sites
ern_emm <- emmeans(brms_ERP_model, pairwise ~ Stimulation | Error , adjust = "bonferroni")

# Conditional effects plot
ce <- conditional_effects(brms_ERP_model, effect = "Stimulation:Error")

plot(ce, ask = FALSE)[[1]] +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("blue", "red")) +  # line colors
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("red", "blue"))      # ribbon colors


```

## RT calculation
```{r}
# ── Unnest times_used from df_ern_peaks into long format ──────────────────────
df_times_long <- df_ern_peaks %>%
  dplyr::select(Subject, Stimulation, peak_time, times_used) %>%
  unnest(times_used) %>%
  rename(Time = times_used)

# ── Load new beta dataset ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df_betas <- read_excel("Data2Regress_betas_FCz_Simple_Error_Model_Incong_RT_250801.xlsx")

# Make sure factor levels match
df_betas$Subject     <- as.factor(df_betas$Subject)
df_betas$Stimulation <- factor(df_betas$Stimulation,
                                levels = c(1, 2, 3),
                                labels = c("aMCC", "SHAM", "PCC"))

# ── Match betas to ERN time windows ───────────────────────────────────────────
df_betas_ern <- df_betas %>%
  inner_join(df_times_long, by = c("Subject", "Stimulation", "Time"))

# ── Average betas within each subject's ERN window ────────────────────────────
df_betas_summary <- df_betas_ern %>%
  group_by(Subject, Stimulation, peak_time) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Beta      = mean(Betas, na.rm = TRUE),
    times_used     = list(sort(unique(Time))),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

print(df_betas_summary)

df_betas_summary_all <- df_betas_ern %>%
  group_by(Stimulation) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Beta      = mean(Betas, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_Beta      = sd(Betas, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

print(df_betas_summary_all)


```

# Run Bayes repeated-measures ANOVA on ERN peaks for RT (70 - 120 ms)

```{r}
df_betas_summary$Stimulation <- relevel(df_betas_summary$Stimulation,"SHAM")
#baseline beta values Mean = 0.5; SD = 3.5
priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 3), class = "Intercept"),
    prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "b", coef= "StimulationPCC"),
    prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "b", coef= "StimulationaMCC"),
  prior(exponential(0.3), class = "sd"),      # mean ≈ 3.3
  prior(exponential(0.3), class = "sigma")
)

#fit_prior <- brm(
#  Mean_Beta ~ Stimulation + (1|Subject),
#  data = df_betas_peak_summary,
#  prior = priors,
#  sample_prior = "only"
#)

#pp_check(fit_prior)

# ── Fit Bayesian repeated measures model ──────────────────────────────────────
# Equivalent to repeated measures ANOVA:
# ERN ~ Stimulation + (1 | Subject)

fit_brm <- brm(
  formula   = Mean_Beta ~ Stimulation + (1+Stimulation|| Subject),
  data      = df_betas_summary,
  family = gaussian(),
  prior     = priors,
  chains    = 4,
  iter      = 6000,
  warmup    = 2000,
  cores     = 4,
  seed      = 42,
  control   = list(adapt_delta = 0.95)  # increase if divergences occur
)

# ── Model summary ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
summary(fit_brm)

# Posterior distributions for fixed effects
plot(fit_brm, variable = "^b_", regex = TRUE)


```

```{r}
#Plot results
emm_ern <- emmeans(fit_brm, ~ Stimulation, re_formula = NA)
pairs(emm_ern, adjust = "holm")
contrast_draws <- contrast(emm_ern, method = "pairwise") %>% 
  gather_emmeans_draws()

ggplot(contrast_draws, aes(x = .value, y = contrast)) +
  stat_halfeye() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Posterior Difference",
    y = "",
    title = "Posterior Distributions of Contrasts"
  )
```

```{r}
# ── Compute Bayes Factors for each contrast via Savage-Dickey ─────────────────
# Tests whether contrast is credibly different from 0
library(bayestestR)

# Posterior samples for all parameters
posterior_draws <- as_draws_df(fit_brm)

# Condition means from posterior
aMCC_draws  <- posterior_draws$b_Intercept + posterior_draws$b_StimulationaMCC                              
sham_draws   <- posterior_draws$b_Intercept 
PCC_draws <- posterior_draws$b_Intercept + posterior_draws$b_StimulationPCC

# Pairwise difference distributions
contrasts_posterior <- data.frame(
  aMCC_vs_SHAM   = aMCC_draws - sham_draws,
  aMCC_vs_PCC = aMCC_draws - PCC_draws,
  SHAM_vs_PCC  = sham_draws  - PCC_draws
)

# Bayes Factor via Savage-Dickey density ratio (BF10: H1 vs H0: diff = 0)
bf_contrasts <- sapply(contrasts_posterior, function(diff_samples) {
  bf <- bayesfactor_pointnull(diff_samples, null = 0)
  return(as.numeric(bf$BF))
})

# Posterior summaries for each contrast
contrast_summary_RT <- contrasts_posterior %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Contrast", values_to = "Difference") %>%
  group_by(Contrast) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_diff  = mean(Difference),
    Median_diff = median(Difference),
    SD_diff    = sd(Difference),
    Lower_95CI = quantile(Difference, 0.025),
    Upper_95CI = quantile(Difference, 0.975),
    P_gt_0     = mean(Difference > 0),   # posterior probability of positive difference
    .groups    = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    BF10 = bf_contrasts,
    Evidence = case_when(
      BF10 > 100  ~ "Extreme evidence for H1",
      BF10 > 30   ~ "Very strong evidence for H1",
      BF10 > 10   ~ "Strong evidence for H1",
      BF10 > 3    ~ "Moderate evidence for H1",
      BF10 > 1    ~ "Anecdotal evidence for H1",
      BF10 == 1   ~ "No evidence",
      BF10 > 1/3  ~ "Anecdotal evidence for H0",
      BF10 > 1/10 ~ "Moderate evidence for H0",
      TRUE        ~ "Strong evidence for H0"
    )
  )

print(contrast_summary_RT)

# ── Visualise posterior distributions of condition means ──────────────────────
condition_posteriors <- data.frame(
  aMCC  = aMCC_draws,
  SHAM   = sham_draws,
  PCC = PCC_draws
) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Stimulation", values_to = "ERN") %>%
  mutate(Stimulation = factor(Stimulation, levels = c("aMCC", "SHAM", "PCC")))

ggplot(condition_posteriors, aes(x = ERN, fill = Stimulation, color = Stimulation)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  labs(
    title    = "Posterior Distributions of Betas by Stimulation",
    subtitle = "Shaded area = posterior density; dashed line = zero",
    x        = "Estimates",
    y        = "Density"
  ) +
   scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "aMCC"  = "#CC6677",  # reddish purple
    "SHAM"   = "#E69F00",  # orange/yellow
    "PCC" = "#56B4E9"   # sky blue
  )) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "aMCC"  = "#CC6677",
    "SHAM"   = "#E69F00",
    "PCC" = "#56B4E9"
  )) +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
    "PCC" = "#56B4E9"   # sky blue
  )) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "aMCC"  = "#CC79A7",
    "SHAM"   = "#E69F00",
    "PCC" = "#56B4E9"
  )) +
  theme_classic()
```

#Load & clean 
```{r load-betas}
df_betas_raw <- read_excel(
  "Data2Regress_betas_FCz_Simple_Error_Model_Incong_BlockLevel_3stages_acc_260508.xlsx"
)

df_betas <- df_betas_raw %>%
  mutate(
    # FIX: European decimal commas → numeric (e.g. "-3,3972" → -3.3972)
    Betas       = if (is.character(Betas)) as.numeric(str_replace(Betas, ",", "."))
                  else as.numeric(Betas),
    Subject     = as.factor(Subject),
    Stimulation = as.factor(Stimulation),
    Block       = factor(Block,
                         levels = c(1, 5, 9),
                         labels = c("Early", "Middle", "Late")),
    Time        = as.numeric(Time)
  )

n_na <- sum(is.na(df_betas$Betas))
if (n_na > 0) warning(sprintf("%d NA(s) in Betas after conversion.", n_na))
```

# Filter to 70–120 ms window
```{r filter-window}
df_window <- df_betas %>%
  filter(Time >= 70, Time <= 120)

message(sprintf("Time points kept: %s", paste(sort(unique(df_window$Time)), collapse = ", ")))
message(sprintf("Rows after filter: %d", nrow(df_window)))
```

# Average betas per Subject × Block × Stimulation 
```{r summarise-subject}
df_subject <- df_window %>%
  group_by(Subject, Stimulation, Block) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Beta = mean(Betas, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

print(df_subject)
```

#Group mean ± SE for the main line 
```{r summarise-group}
df_group <- df_subject %>%
  group_by(Stimulation, Block) %>%
  summarise(
    Grand_Mean = mean(Mean_Beta, na.rm = TRUE),
    SE         = sd(Mean_Beta,   na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

print(df_group)
```


```{r}
ggplot(df_group, aes(x = Block, y = Grand_Mean, color = Stimulation, group = Stimulation)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = Grand_Mean - SE, ymax = Grand_Mean + SE, fill = Stimulation),
    alpha = 0.15, color = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +  
  scale_color_manual(values = stim_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = stim_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "ERN Betas (70–120 ms) by Block and Stimulation Condition",
    subtitle = "Mean ± SE across subjects",
    x = "Block", y = "Mean Beta (µV)", color = "Stimulation", fill = "Stimulation"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title  = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text   = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title  = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey45")
  )
```
```{r}
df_subject$Stimulation <- relevel(df_subject$Stimulation,"sham")
priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0.1, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b", coef = "Stimulationverum"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b", coef = "Stimulationactive"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 2.5), class = "sd"),   
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 2.5), class = "sigma")
)

# ── Fit Bayesian repeated measures model ──────────────────────────────────────
# Equivalent to repeated measures ANOVA:
# N2 ~ Stimulation + (1 | Subject)

fit_brm <- brm(
  formula   = Mean_Beta ~ Stimulation*Block + (1 +Stimulation*Block|| Subject),
  data      = df_subject,
#  prior     = priors,
  #sample_prior = "only",
  chains    = 4,
  iter      = 6000,
  warmup    = 2000,
  cores     = 4,
  seed      = 42,
  control   = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 12)  # increase if divergences occur
)
#save(fit_brm, file = "Bayes_model_EEGbetas_N2_longmodel_Cong_260508.RData")
# ── Model summary ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
summary(fit_brm)

# Posterior distributions for fixed effects
plot(fit_brm, variable = "^b_", regex = TRUE)
```
